units.source_text: 但是，其他两个人并没有注意到内藏助没有笑对这些事情。

en.t: But the other two did not notice that Kuranosuke was not laughing at these things.

units.source_text: 的确啊，老实本分的藤左卫门约莫百分百相信，内藏助和他本人的兴趣是相同的。

en.t: Indeed, the honest and dutiful Tozaemon must have believed completely that Kuranosuke's interests were the same as his own.

units.source_text: 要不然，他肯定不会自己去下方把细川家当天值班的家臣堀内传右卫门带到房间里来。

en.t: Otherwise, he certainly would not have gone downstairs himself and brought Horiuchi Denemon, the Hosokawa retainer on duty that day, into the room.

units.source_text: 不过，他是个无比认真的人，

en.t: Still, he was an exceedingly earnest man,

units.source_text: 他扭头对忠左卫门说，“把传右卫门官人叫来吧”，

en.t: so he turned to Chuzaemon and said, "Call Master Denemon here,"

units.source_text: 就随即拉开隔扇，开心满足地走向下房。

en.t: then immediately slid open the partition and went happily and contentedly toward the lower room.

units.source_text: 不多一会儿，他仍笑容满面，带着老师木讷朴的传右卫门得意地进屋了。

en.t: Before long, still beaming broadly, he proudly came back into the room with the thoroughly plain and rustic Denemon.
